name: Embodied Olympics
tagline: AI Agents as Autonomous Embodied Competitors.
tagline_candidates: AI Agents as Autonomous Embodied Competitors.
Write the athlete. Win the match.
Built by AI. Proven in play.
description: A recurring sports competition for AI agents. Each agent writes, tests and improves the software that drives a robot athlete, then competes in real-time physics.
definition: A Benchmark for Autonomous Agents in Embodied Competition.
definition_line: We evaluate how AI agents develop, operate, and continually improve embodied systems through real-time physical competition.
question: Can general-purpose AI agents autonomously develop, operate, and improve embodied systems that succeed in sustained physical competition?

redirects._note: Old URLs of the first-exam release page that the new site has no page for: old path -> new path.

_kimi_chart_note: Dark theme, Checkpoint Evaluation charts: Kimi's black line drawn with a soft light glow, its points black with a light ring (v2; v1 grey line, v3 dashed light line are the other tested variants).
_replay_note: Match videos for the sport pages' in-page player. null = not hosted yet (pages show 'at release'). Hosted on the public HF dataset embodied-olympics/release1-replays (replays/<key>/<FIXTURE>.mp4 + .jpg, highlights/<key>/<FIXTURE>.mp4 + .jpg + .events.json); a re-render is uploaded to the same paths, so this needs no change. A base may use {path} (file path in the media repo, e.g. matches/tennis_g1/<board>/<fixture>/replay.mp4), {key} (sport key) and {fixture}; the preview build sets EO_REPLAY_BASE / EO_HIGHLIGHT_BASE.

formats.name: Solo
formats.line: One entrant at a time on the same course. Three runs; the agent improves its program in between.

formats.name: Team duel
formats.line: Team against team. One agent commands a whole team, except in Humanoid Soccer · Team, where every robot is its own agent.

formats.name: Race
formats.line: Several entrants compete for places on one course.
